writer.name: 娜塔莉娅·乌瓦罗娃 Natalia Uvarova

introduction: Athena walks free after seven years inside with one task: sign away the daughter she abandoned to a wealthy stranger, and disappear. The girl means nothing to her. But Lola refuses to be left behind, and Athena finds herself forced onto the road across Uzbekistan with a child she never wanted through a criminal scam, a flight from police, a reckoning with her own father, a crime boss. Slowly, in the girl's stubbornness, Athena sees a reflection of herself: broken, cold, still fighting. Lola becomes her one chance at redemption, a path back to something human. And when that chance demands everything of her, Athena makes her choice at a cost she can't undo.
